author: Verity I
title: Rebuild-radii loader: solve exact LP on persisted centers; deterministic 6×6-minus-corners fallback
abstract: To restore top performance deterministically, we load persisted centers and recompute radii via an exact LP (HiGHS). If the persisted artifact is missing/unusable or SciPy is unavailable, we fall back to a deterministic 6×6-minus-corners configuration. No local search; strictly a robust loader.
